files.agent-runtime/contained-files.ts: No-follow directory-fd primitives, the Darwin FFI binding and the contained-file scan in one file; the Darwin binding and the scan/walk each deserve a file.
files.agent-runtime/schemas.ts: A schema file: Zod schemas for agent messages, runs, operations, terminal reasons, costs and snapshots with one mapping helper; size is the vocabulary.
files.agent-runtime/store-conformance.ts: Conformance suite for AgentRuntimeStore with one 516-line scenario; splitting that scenario into named ones like ledger/archive already are shrinks it.
files.application/admission.ts: Zod policy/snapshot schemas plus the createBoundedAdmission closure; the schemas are declarative, the closure is the real size (see its function entry).
files.application/watch-hub.ts: Nearly all of it is createWatchHub; per-key source pumping and frame building are the part that would leave with a Source module.
files.browser/client.ts: Typed client factory, scoped registries, two executors and URL builders; the fetch/http executors (~190 lines) and the URL builders are the natural cut.
files.browser/http.ts: Error mapping, the retry-aware fetch wrapper and createHttpClient; createRetryAwareFetch and the Bun network-retry predicates are a separable module.
files.browser/live-state.ts: Status schema plus createLiveStateController, one ~410-line closure; the file is big because the closure is (see its function entry).
files.browser/socket-io.ts: Peer loader/resolver, packet identity, bindRealtimeClient and the Socket.IO client closure in one place; the loader/resolver and bindRealtimeClient each go to own files.
files.contract/define.ts: Mostly endpoint-definition types (one variant per body/response kind) plus ~200 lines of assert* definition checks; the assertions move to a define-validation module.
files.declaration/declaration.ts: A schema file: one Zod schema per project-declaration record (paths, listeners, roles, builds, env) with refinements; size is the vocabulary.
files.files/boundary.ts: Root binding, fd-level read/write primitives and the createManagedFileBoundary facade; the inspect/readHandle/writeSource primitives move to a file-io module.
files.server/implement.ts: Contract binding, scoped implement and the keyed registry live together; the registry half (bindRegistry, implementRegistry and its ~60 lines of mapped types) is a file of its own.
files.server/middleware/auth.ts: JWT sign/verify, ~250 lines of type-level contribution merging, and the auth hook composers; JWT helpers belong in their own jwt.ts, the type algebra is what is left.
files.server/multipart.ts: A streaming multipart/form-data parser: byte search helpers, header/disposition parsing, the part reader class and parseMultipart; the reader class and the collect/limit helpers split apart.
files.server/oauth/provider.ts: Whole OAuth authorization server in one file: CIMD metadata fetch/cache resolver plus four endpoint handlers; CIMD to its own module and one factory per endpoint is the cut.
files.server/types.ts: Type vocabulary only: handler contexts, method/service defs, hooks, raw routes, logging and handler config; no runtime code, size is the surface area of the server API.
files.server/unix-client-bun.ts: Almost all of it is bunUnixRequest, a hand-rolled HTTP/1.1 client over a Bun unix socket; moving the response parser (headers, chunked, plain) to a pure module is the cut.
files.testing/surface-conformance.ts: Test harness: realtime probe driver, discovery assertions and bounded probe runner; the realtime probe driver (createRealtimeProbeDriver) is a separate concern and file.
files.testing/surface-manifest.ts: Manifest Zod schemas, canonical digest helpers and buildSurfaceManifest; the digest/fingerprint helpers split cleanly from the builder.
files.tools/cli/args.ts: Argv routing, schema-field collection/coercion, parseCliArgs, global options and result-view resolution; schema-field coercion and resolveCliView are two separable modules.
files.tools/execute.ts: ~200 lines of hook/lifecycle types, argument parsing and the runToolMethod pipeline; the hook vocabulary types can leave for a types file.
files.tools/mcp/round.ts: Round-state helpers and the resolveMcpRound pipeline; just over the limit, and the function cut (pre-resolution checks) takes it under.
files.tracking/client.ts: Config types plus createTrackingClient, which is ~390 lines; the size is the closure (see its function entry), not the file.

functions.agent-runtime/coding-shell-process.ts#ru: One promise closure over a child process: output retention/preview, artifact capture, timeout/cancel termination; output retention+artifact persistence is the cut.
functions.agent-runtime/coding-tool-search-patch.t: Defines the search and patch tools as two ~100-line inline handlers; each handler as a top-level function brings this under 30 lines.
functions.agent-runtime/harness-control.ts#createA: Control server whose request handler branches on attach/detach/snapshot/interrupt over shared attachment state; one function per operation is the cut.
functions.agent-runtime/harness.ts#createHeadlessA: Harness closure: profile emission, prompt, pending approvals and a 70-line respondToApproval; the approval part (list/respond) is its own module.
functions.agent-runtime/schedules.ts#createAgentSc: Schedule service with timer arming, claim, a 114-line runTick and a 78-line scheduleInput; runTick and input validation are the extractable parts.
functions.agent-runtime/store-conformance.ts#confo: One sequential scenario asserting admission, fencing/checkpoint, loadRun/listActiveRuns, terminal race and abandon recovery; one named scenario per group.
functions.application/admission.ts#createBoundedAd: Single admission state machine (accepting/draining/closed) over per-key and global rate samples; the rate-sample pruning/retry-after math is a pure module.
functions.application/diagnostic-journal-manager.t: Journal state machine (open/failed/closed) with ~15 counters and a writer worker; the counters and status projection could become a small state object.
functions.application/notification-outbox.ts#creat: Lease-based outbox: config bounds, enqueue/claim/ack/reject and the flush loop; the pure state transitions (claim/ack/reject on the parsed state) can leave the closure.
functions.application/schedule.ts#createManagedSch: Schedule lifecycle over ~15 mutable fields (timer, overlap queue, run counters, timestamps); moving counters+status() into a status record and arm/tick into a timer part.
functions.application/watch-hub.ts#createWatchHub: Shared-source watch hub: source refcount/hold, baseline+delta frames, per-source pump, attach/close; a Source object owning pump/frameFor/adoptBaseline is the cut.
functions.browser/http.ts#createHttpClient: ky instance setup with SSR cookies, logout state, event listeners and a 96-line request wrapper; the request wrapper and error-event emission can be split.
functions.browser/live-state.ts#createLiveStateCon: Generation-based live state machine (open, apply, resync, publish) with subscriber error reporting; generation lifecycle (openGeneration/begin/resync) is the cut.
functions.browser/socket-io.ts#createSocketIOClien: Socket.IO client closure: socket open, request-phase listeners, connect/disconnect, on, emitWithAck; emitWithAck ack/timeout bookkeeping is the cut.
functions.durability/engine.ts#createLocalStepDura: Step/sleep/waitFor durability over a shared in-flight ledger view; each primitive is small, the ledger read cache and in-flight registry are the shared state to lift.
functions.live/watch-client.ts#createWatchClient: Client watch entries plus frame application (full/delta/unchanged) and transport open; the frame-apply logic is a pure function over Entry and the obvious cut.
functions.realtime/registry.ts#bindSocketRegistry: Room membership registry with replay/resync and connection setup over one members map; member replay/resync is the part that splits out.
functions.server/bun.ts#createServer: Unix/TCP listen config, WebSocket open-socket tracking and graceful-shutdown adapter in one closure; the socket-drain tracker and the unix listen branch can be extracted.
functions.server/oauth/provider.ts#mountOAuthProvi: Mounts metadata, register, authorize and token endpoints as inline handlers over shared stores; one factory per endpoint taking the store/config would shrink it.
functions.server/streaming-route.ts#handler: Per-request state (iterator, heartbeat, demand, departed) with a 127-line ReadableStream start; the frame pump with heartbeat/backpressure is the cut from release/teardown.
functions.server/streaming-route.ts#streamingRoute: Is almost entirely its inner handler (see that entry); shrinks when the handler does.
functions.server/unix-client-bun.ts#bunUnixRequest: One closure over the socket's read buffer and response state: header parsing, chunked and plain pumps, request flush; a pure incremental HTTP/1.1 response parser is the cut.
functions.server/unix-client.ts#createUnixClientTr: Config validation plus the dispatch closure over agent/active sets; its size is dispatch (see that entry), the option parsing is ~40 lines.
functions.server/unix-client.ts#dispatch: Two runtime paths (Bun fetch-over-unix and node:http request) with redirect handling repeated in each; the node:http branch and a shared redirect step are the cut.
functions.testing/surface-manifest.ts#buildSurface: Builds operations from HTTP and tool projections through inner addOperation/addHttp/addToolProjection; addToolProjection (62 lines) can be a top-level function.
functions.tools/cli/args.ts#parseCliArgs: Two phases in one function: tokenising flags (with pollution/repeat/root-conflict refusals) and building the argument object from positionals; the phases are the cut.
functions.tools/execute.ts#runToolMethod: Tool call pipeline with ordered before-hook, argument replacement, execution and single-exit after-hook; the before-hook/argument-replacement stage is the cut.
functions.tools/mcp/round.ts#resolveMcpRound: Ordered MCP elicitation round: identity/argument checks, guard, resolver, plan digest, answers; pre-resolution checks and post-resolution plan compare split cleanly.
functions.tracking/client.ts#createTrackingClient: Attribution, visit bootstrap, outbox delivery and a start() that wires page listeners (hide, heartbeat, scroll); the listener wiring in start() is the cut.
